Yamaha branding is visible on both the front and rear panels.

risks.risk: Keys or control buttons may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip of every key being played and buttons being pressed to change voices.

risks.risk: Battery compartment may be corroded or missing the cover.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the keyboard with the battery cover removed.

risks.risk: Internal speaker may be blown or producing distorted sound.
risks.proof: A video clip with clear audio of the keyboard playing at various volumes.
A photo of the DC power adapter if it is included in the sale.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard being powered on and every key being played.
Photo of the underside of the unit.
response.reason: The witness has positively identified the specific model as a Yamaha PSS-12, which allows for a worst-case valuation despite the lack of functional testing.
